packs.name: Claws Mail
packs.description: Fast, light email client (GTK). The recommended mail app on LinPad.

packs.name: Thunderbird
packs.description: Mozilla's full email client. Gecko engine like Firefox: large, slow to start under emulation.

packs.name: PDF viewer (zathura)
packs.description: Keyboard-driven document viewer with the MuPDF backend. Files › Quick Look also previews PDFs natively.

packs.name: LibreOffice
packs.description: Writer, Calc and Impress. Very large; first start takes a while under emulation. Not yet verified under LinPad's emulator.

packs.name: GIMP
packs.description: Raster image editor (GIMP 2.10, runs through its own Xwayland).

packs.name: Image viewer (Ristretto)
packs.description: Light image viewer from Xfce, the same family as Thunar.

packs.name: Archive manager (Xarchiver)
packs.description: Open and create zip, tar, 7z and other archives. Files can also compress and extract.

packs.name: Visual Studio Code
packs.description: Microsoft's VS Code, downloaded from code.visualstudio.com on this iPad. Needs about 900 MB and 2–3 GB of memory while running.

packs.name: Claude Code
packs.description: Anthropic's AI coding agent for the terminal (the claude command), installed from npm on this iPad. Proprietary: use is subject to Anthropic's terms. Needs about 470 MB.

packs.name: Windows apps (Wine)
packs.description: Runs Windows programs built for ARM64 (Notepad++, 7-Zip, PuTTY, Wine's own Notepad, Minesweeper and settings) in one Windows desktop window. Wine 10 from Debian, downloaded on this iPad. Direct3D 9 can draw on the iPad's GPU; Direct3D 10/11/12 games do not run (no DXVK or Proton on this GPU). About 600 MB, plus about 540 MB for the Windows folder the first program creates.

packs.name: Windows x86 apps (Wine + Box64)
packs.description: Adds 32- and 64-bit Intel Windows programs to Wine through the Box64 translator (installs Windows apps (Wine) too). Usable speed needs fast mode (native JIT); a few programs take 1.5-2 GB of memory. No DXVK or Proton, so modern 3D games do not run. About 1.1 GB more, plus a second Windows folder.

packs.name: VLC media player
packs.description: Plays video and audio files, with LinPad's native video window and sound. Includes internet radio: a Radio (VLC) launcher with 45 stations by genre (news, chill, jazz, classical, rock, electronic, talk, Romania, UK) and VLC's Icecast directory of thousands more.

packs.name: Extra browsers (Falkon, Dillo)
packs.description: Falkon (Qt WebEngine) and Dillo (tiny, X11). Falkon does not start yet in this build; Dillo works. Firefox stays the default browser.

packs.name: Developer extras
packs.description: Python 3 with pip, C/C++ toolchain (build-base, cmake), Go and Rust. Command-line only.

packs.name: GPU tools
packs.description: glxinfo, eglinfo and the Mesa demos for checking the Venus/zink GPU path (vulkaninfo and vkcube are already installed).

packs.name: Camera (Cheese)
packs.description: Take photos and videos with the iPad's front and back cameras, which LinPad passes to Linux as webcams. GNOME's Cheese; photos go to ~/Pictures/Webcam, videos to ~/Videos/Webcam. Its live preview is drawn without the GPU, so it uses a lot of CPU while open.

packs.name: Document Scanner (OCR)
packs.description: Photograph pages with the iPad camera and get a searchable PDF plus the text (Tesseract OCR, English and Romanian), saved in ~/Documents/Scans. Also reads text from photos you drop in: linpad-scan --ocr photo.jpg. Runs in a terminal window.

packs.name: Sound Recorder
packs.description: Record from the iPad's microphone, with pause, playback and a list of recordings (GNOME Sound Recorder). Recordings are kept in ~/Music/Recordings.

packs.name: Notes (Zim)
packs.description: A notebook of linked pages with checklists, images and search (Zim Desktop Wiki). Notes are plain text files in ~/Notes, so git, VS Code and grep can use them.

packs.name: Calendar and to-dos (calcurse)
packs.description: A small calendar and to-do list for the terminal. It can import the events LinPad's Calendar exports for Linux: calcurse -i ~/Calendar/linpad.ics. Command-line only; the iPad's own calendars are in LinPad's Calendar app.
